title: Understanding Logistic Regression: Predicting Categorical Outcomes

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we've got a very exciting tutorial.
cues.zh: 今天的教學很精彩。

cues.en: We're talking about the logistic regression.
cues.zh: 要談的是邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: The logistic regression is used to predict a categorical dependent variable from a number of independent variables.
cues.zh: 它透過多個自變數，預測類別型的應變數。

cues.en: So, the key difference to a linear regression here is that we're not predicting a continuous variable, we're predicting a categorical variable.
cues.zh: 和線性迴歸的主要差異，是不預測連續變數，而是預測類別。

cues.en: For example, you might be working for an insurance company and you want to predict will somebody purchase the health insurance that your company is offering,
cues.zh: 例如在保險公司工作，想預測某人是否會購買公司提供的健康保險，

cues.en: yes or no, and it's very simple, yes or no.
cues.zh: 很簡單，就是「是」或「否」。

cues.en: It's a categorical variable.
cues.zh: 這是類別變數。

cues.en: And you might want to be predicting this dependent variable based on an independent variable such as age.
cues.zh: 可能想依年齡這個自變數，預測這個應變數。

cues.en: So, depending on their age, will they purchase the health insurance plan that your company is offering?
cues.zh: 根據年齡，他們會不會購買公司的健保方案？

cues.en: So, on the x-axis, we would have age, and on the y-xis, we would have yes or no, did they take up the offer or not.
cues.zh: x 軸放年齡，y 軸放是否接受方案。

cues.en: Let's say our x-axis is somewhere between 18 years of age and 60 years of age, and our y-axis simply has binary outcomes, yes and no.
cues.zh: 假設 x 軸是 18 到 60 歲，y 軸只有二元結果：是或否。

cues.en: So, there's no in between. It's either yes or no.
cues.zh: 沒有中間值，不是是，就是否。

cues.en: So, we're going to just add this horizontal line for illustrative purposes.
cues.zh: 為了說明，加上這條水平線。

cues.en: So, what will our data set look like?
cues.zh: 資料集會長什麼樣？

cues.en: Let's say we've got certain number of observations in our dataset.
cues.zh: 假設資料集有一定數量的觀測值。

cues.en: So, we know people's age and we know when they were exposed to the offer, whether they purchased or didn't.
cues.zh: 我們知道每個人的年齡，以及看到方案後有沒有購買。

cues.en: So, these people over here didn't purchase the health insurance, and these people over here did purchase the health insurance, and that's our dataset.
cues.zh: 這些人沒有買健康保險，這些人有買，這就是資料集。

cues.en: So, as you can see, it's very different.
cues.zh: 如你所見，差異很大。

cues.en: This plot looks very different to what we were working with in the linear regression tutorials.
cues.zh: 圖形和線性迴歸教學裡處理的很不同。

cues.en: So, we can't simply draw a linear regression line, a sloped line through these points.
cues.zh: 所以不能直接畫一條有斜率的線性迴歸線穿過這些點。

cues.en: It makes no sense.
cues.zh: 那沒有意義。

cues.en: So, that's why the equation for logistic regression is slightly different.
cues.zh: 因此邏輯斯迴歸的方程式稍微不同。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: So, here on the left, we've got, instead of Y, we've got a logarithm.
cues.zh: 左側不是 y，而是對數。

cues.en: And then on the right, we've got the same part as we saw before.
cues.zh: 右側則和以前相同。

cues.en: The important value to us here is p, and that is the probability that we will be working with just now.
cues.zh: 重要的值是 p，也就是接下來要用的機率。

cues.en: We'll see it in action.
cues.zh: 會實際看看。

cues.en: So, let's look at the logistic regression curve.
cues.zh: 先看邏輯斯迴歸曲線。

cues.en: The logistic regression curve looks like this, and it's also called the sigmoid curve.
cues.zh: 它長這樣，也稱為 sigmoid 曲線。

cues.en: And how does this work in action?
cues.zh: 實際上如何運作？

cues.en: Well, let's say we have two new observations.
cues.zh: 假設有兩筆新觀測。

cues.en: Let's say we've built this model based on this data, we have a logistic regression.
cues.zh: 已根據這些資料建立邏輯斯迴歸模型。

cues.en: How will it apply to new observations?
cues.zh: 如何套用到新觀測？

cues.en: Well, let's say we have two new observations, somebody of age 35 and somebody of age 45.
cues.zh: 假設一個人 35 歲，另一個 45 歲。

cues.en: What we do is we will need to project these values onto our logistic regression, find out where they fit there, and the logistic regression will give us probability.
cues.zh: 將年齡投影到曲線，找到對應位置，模型就會給出機率。

cues.en: So, this value, everything here is between zero and one.
cues.zh: 這裡所有數值都在 0 到 1 之間。

cues.en: So, no is a zero, yes is a one.
cues.zh: 否是 0，是是 1。

cues.en: And in between are the probabilities.
cues.zh: 中間則是機率。

cues.en: So, the logistic regression gives us probabilities of somebody saying yes.
cues.zh: 模型給的是某人回答「是」的機率。

cues.en: So, somebody taking up that offer.
cues.zh: 也就是接受方案的機率。

cues.en: So, for the 35-year-old, it's a 42% chance that they will take up the offer based on this model.
cues.zh: 依模型，35 歲的人有 42% 機率接受。

cues.en: So, this is what the model is predicting.
cues.zh: 這就是模型的預測。

cues.en: It's predicting a 42% chance they will take up the offer, and for the 45-year-old, there's an 81% chance they will take up the offer.
cues.zh: 預測 35 歲有 42% 機率接受，45 歲則有 81%。

cues.en: So, we could stop there.
cues.zh: 我們可以到此為止。

cues.en: That is the p.
cues.zh: 這就是 p。

cues.en: That is the probability that we see in the equation on the left that's hidden inside that logarithm.
cues.zh: 也就是左邊公式對數裡的機率。

cues.en: So, we could stop there and we could use these probabilities and in some use cases that's what the logistic regression is used for.
cues.zh: 有些應用確實只使用邏輯斯迴歸給出的機率。

cues.en: We just deal with the probabilities once we have them.
cues.zh: 得到機率後，直接使用。

cues.en: But in most cases, we want a binary outcome, a yes or no outcome.
cues.zh: 但大多數情況，我們要的是二元的是或否。

cues.en: And so for those situations, we split our curve into two, our plot into two.
cues.zh: 這時將曲線、圖形分成兩部分。

cues.en: Anything above this line, this middle line, anything above with a probability of 50% of higher will be projected into a yes, into a binary one.
cues.zh: 中間這條線以上，也就是機率達 50% 或更高，就投影成「是」，二元值 1。

cues.en: And anything below the 50% line will be projected into a no, a binary zero.
cues.zh: 低於 50%，則投影成「否」，二元值 0。

cues.en: Our points would end up here.
cues.zh: 這些點會落在這裡。

cues.en: So, based on this logistic regression we would make the conclusion that the 35-year-old would not purchase our insurance plan and the 45-year-old would purchase our insurance plan.
cues.zh: 所以模型判斷，35 歲不會購買，45 歲會購買保險方案。

cues.en: And just like with linear regression, you can have multiple independent variables.
cues.zh: 和線性迴歸一樣，也可以有多個自變數。

cues.en: So, for instance, age, income, level of education, how big their family is, or whether they have a family, or they're single.
cues.zh: 例如年齡、收入、教育程度、家庭人數，或是否有家庭、是否單身。

cues.en: And many other types of variables can be added depending on the use case.
cues.zh: 可依應用情境加入其他變數。

cues.en: And our equation will look like this in this situation.
cues.zh: 此時方程式會像這樣。

cues.en: So, there you go. That's logistic regression in a nutshell.
cues.zh: 這就是邏輯斯迴歸的簡要介紹。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
